title: Analyste de la performance de la flotte / Fleet Performance Analyst
desc: Job Description: Analyste de la performance de la flotte / Fleet Performance Analyst ***English job description follows*** Description de l'emploi : Vous possédez une expérience en analyse de données ? Vous avez travaillé dans ce domaine et souhaitez évoluer ainsi que développer de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est fait pour vous ! Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est à la recherche d'un Analyste Performance de la flotte pour rejoindre notre équipe Performance de la flotte basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada). À ce titre, vous soutiendrez l'équipe dans le cadre d'initiatives et de projets visant à améliorer la fiabilité opérationnelle, la disponibilité des aéronefs et à réduire les coûts de maintenance de la flotte A220. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement. Votre rôle sert de passerelle entre l'analyse de données avancée et l'exécution stratégique. Agissant à la fois comme scientifique des données et gestionnaire de projet technique, vous contribuerez non seulement à la conception de modèles de données, de pipelines et de tableaux de bord mettant en lumière les leviers de performance de la flotte, mais vous pilotez également la gouvernance, la coordination interfonctionnelle et l'exécution de projets nécessaires pour convertir ces analyses en valeur commerciale concrète pour la flotte A220. Votre environnement de travail: Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre. Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions. Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle. Bien-être / santé : Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel, et une application de covoiturage. Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale). Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. Vos défis: ● Soutenir les activités de suivi et d'optimisation de la fiabilité opérationnelle, de la disponibilité des aéronefs et des coûts de maintenance de la flotte A220; ● Appuyer les opérations de l'équipe Performance de la flotte par le traitement de données, l'analyse avancée et l'évaluation de l'efficacité des solutions en service; ● Collaborer avec les fonctions métiers afin de générer des informations analytiques exploitables et traduire les enjeux opérationnels en opportunités concrètes liées à l'intelligence artificielle; ● Mener le développement de bout en bout de modèles d'IA / d'apprentissage automatique (ML), de l'idéation préliminaire, l'exploration et les études de faisabilité jusqu'à la conception, au développement et au déploiement de services d'IA créateurs de valeur opérationnelle; ● Collaborer avec les parties prenantes interfonctionnelles pour traduire les besoins opérationnels en outils numériques fonctionnels ; soutenir leur développement de bout en bout, leur déploiement, leur adoption par les utilisateurs ainsi que leur promotion active auprès des différents départements; ● Agir à titre de gestionnaire principal des données (data manager), responsable de surveiller la santé des pipelines, d'élaborer les mécanismes de validation et de détecter proactivement les anomalies, ruptures de schéma ou données manquantes afin de garantir un niveau optimal d'intégrité, de fiabilité et de disponibilité sur l'ensemble des jeux de données de la flotte; ● Agir à titre de gestionnaire de projet pour coordonner les projets transversaux touchant le périmètre et les opérations quotidiennes de l'équipe. Votre profil: ● Baccalauréat en ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique ou dans une discipline technique connexe; ● Plus de cinq (5) ans d'expérience dans le développement de solutions fondées sur les statistiques avancées, l'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning) et les méthodes d'apprentissage profond (Deep Learning); ● Maîtrise avancée de SQL; ● Maîtrise de Python, y compris des bibliothèques à code source ouvert pertinentes telles que Pandas, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch et PySpark; ● Expérience dans le déploiement et la gestion de modèles au sein d'environnements infonuagiques (cloud), tels qu'AWS ou GCP; ● Connaissance de la plateforme et des outils Skywise, un atout. ● Expérience dans la création de tableaux de bord et de rapports ponctuels (ad hoc) destinés à des auditoires multidisciplinaires à l'aide d'outils de visualisation de données; ● Connaissance des systèmes et composants de l'A220 ou d'avions commerciaux, ainsi que du suivi de la performance en service; ● Compréhension des réglementations sur la protection de la vie privée, de la confidentialité et des politiques d'entreprise; ● Excellentes compétences relationnelles, de communication et de présentation; ● Compétences avérées en leadership; ● Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes complexes; ● Capacité à analyser des données et à présenter des constats stratégiques clés; ● Aptitude à définir, structurer et suivre des projets ou des initiatives; ● Forte motivation pour le soutien et les services aux clients; ● Excellentes compétences de coordination et de relations interpersonnelles pour interagir avec les clients, les partenaires commerciaux et universitaires, les fournisseurs et les autres départements d'Airbus; ● Esprit d'équipe, adaptabilité, ouverture d'esprit et flexibilité; ● Sens de l'initiative, sens des responsabilités et bon jugement ● Débrouillardise, esprit d'analyse et aisance à proposer des solutions concrètes. En raison du secteur d’activité (aéronautique), de multiples contacts avec des entités Airbus situées dans le monde entier, et d’interactions avec les fournisseurs et clients également situés dans le monde entier, la connaissance de l’anglais est demandée dans ce poste. title: Associate Quantitative Researcher - Derivatives
desc: FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations. The Fixed Income & Derivatives Research team is responsible for developing and maintaining FactSet’s proprietary securities pricing models. We are a group of self-driven, articulate, and highly skilled professionals with a unique blend of quantitative and technical expertise. Our work spans both expanding coverage to new instruments and refining existing models, providing end-to-end ownership of the development lifecycle. What we build has downstream impact across the organization - including engineering, product development, model validation, strategy, and sales - making our contributions both visible and critical. As an Associate Quantitative Researcher on the Derivatives team, you will support the implementation and enhancement of pricing models and the systems that underpin them, particularly those related to derivatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team with a broad mandate and high visibility, while developing your skills in a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment. Example projects include: Assisting in the research and prototyping of support for new derivatives such as inflation caps/floors or exotic equity options Contributing to the enhancement and maintenance of existing models (e.g., swaptions, FX options) Supporting internal teams in improving CI/CD workflows Helping build quantitative services for internal and client-facing use The ideal candidate will be eager to learn, comfortable working in a collaborative setting, and able to communicate clearly and effectively. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics Programming experience in Python or Java Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Natural curiosity and creativity Effective communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences Highly Desired: Internship or academic project experience in quantitative research, software engineering, data science, or machine learning Exposure to algorithm development or performance optimization Familiarity with Git and basic repository workflows Interest in financial concepts and service-oriented architecture We offer: A role within the team building our proprietary pricing library, where individual contributions are visible and impactful, and where dedication and initiative are genuinely valued. A collaborative, challenge-driven environment that brings together diverse talents in a friendly, business-casual workplace. Competitive compensation, flexible working hours, and a well-located office space designed to support both focus and teamwork. Apply today and become part of the successful FactSet Fixed Income & Derivatives Research Team! The budgeted salary range for this position in Sofia is 34,220-46,200 Euros. Please note: the salary range may differ in other locations. Company Overview: FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn . At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. title: Sr. Data Scientist
desc: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. (CFG) seeks a Sr. Data Scientist for its Boston, Massachusetts location. Qualifications: Requires a Master’s degree in Quantitative Finance or a related field and 2 years of experience in the position offered, Treasury Associate, or related position developing predictive models for financial services. In the alternative, employer will accept a Bachelor’s degree in the specified fields and 4 years of the specified experience. Must have at least 2 years of experience with the following: • Utilizing quantitative risk management systems for report production, including data input, reconciliation, model management, generating calculations, analyzing economic factors scenarios shocks, and summary reports for WALCO; • Managing treasury models including ALM, balance sheet, and liquidity models, designing statistical models, researching and building mathematical assumptions, considering alternative models, conducting model selection processes, performing data management with work automation in VBA and SQL, conducting quantitative model performance monitoring and proposing model overlay, recalibration, and redevelopment; • Utilizing relational databases, statistical analysis programming languages, and software, including SQL and VBA, to extract high volume and complex data from internal and external databases, including FRED and Bloomberg; • Developing predictive models by implementing data analysis and research, including time series analysis, regression analysis, categorical analysis, advanced econometric techniques related to panel data analysis, and data imputation; • Utilizing the underlying mathematical principles behind statistical methods to evaluate and interpret the results of predictive models in a reasonable manner; • Utilizing advanced statistical programming and visualization software, including VBA and quantitative risk management systems, to create complex reports and graphs; • Building back testing and benchmarking tools to monitor model performance in accordance with established ALM policy; • Implementing complex computational methods and models using 1VBA; and • Standardizing, harmonizing, cleaning, preparing, and using data for developing datasets, reporting and analysis. Remote work permitted 1 day per week. Worksite: 28 State Street, Boston, MA 02109 United States, 40 hrs/wk. Salary Range: $136,781- $165,000/year. EO employer. title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Engineer, Data Annotation Services
desc: Career Area: Technology, Digital and Data Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Help Build the Future of Caterpillar At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers' toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world, on real jobsites, at global scale. You'll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations, over 1.6 million connected assets generating real-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale. Be Part of What's Next in Autonomous Construction Sites Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible, intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites, into reality. Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against. If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You'll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations. Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar. Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior Data QA Engineer to own the quality of training data used for robotics, autonomy, computer vision, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, working within a scrum team. This role combines data quality engineering, test automation, and machine learning to define, measure, and continuously improve the accuracy of annotated and captioned datasets from real-world heavy equipment and construction environments. The successful candidate will build automated validation frameworks and quality metrics and partner with annotation providers, ML engineers, and platform teams to ensure the data feeding Caterpillar's AI models is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy. This position will also evaluate outputs from automated labeling and captioning technologies such as NVIDIA Cosmos Curator and Cosmos Reason. This is a hands-on technical role focused on turning complex data quality challenges into scalable, automated, production-grade quality assurance solutions. What You Will Do: Define, document, and maintain annotation guidelines, acceptance criteria, and quality standards for perception and VLA datasets. Design and execute QA strategies for human, automated, and AI-assisted labeling and captioning, including sampling plans, audits, and golden-set validation. Build automated data validation and test frameworks that verify labeling accuracy, consistency, completeness, schema conformance, and sensor synchronization across camera and LiDAR datasets. Develop quality metrics, dashboards, and alerting capabilities (precision/recall, IoU, inter-annotator agreement, defect rates) to track dataset health and drive measurable quality improvements. Identify, categorize, and root-cause labeling defects, partnering with annotation vendors, ML engineers, and domain experts to resolve issues and improve quality. Build and validate quality gates within data pipelines supporting automated labeling, human review, quality validation, and dataset publication. Evaluate and benchmark auto-labeling and auto-captioning platforms such as NVIDIA Cosmos Curator and Cosmos Reason and help develop AI-driven QA capabilities that scale review processes. Integrate QA workflows with Caterpillar data systems, external annotation providers, and human-in-the-loop processes while ensuring reliability, traceability, and observability. title: Implementation & Trading Risk Analyst
desc: About Us Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients. About the Role THE POSITION The Investment Implementation and Trading department is seeking to recruit a Risk Analyst to work on our IIT Risk team in Boston. The team’s role is to minimize risk by implementing best-in-class, first-line risk management practices throughout the order implementation and trade execution ecosystems. Risks include financial, operational, regulatory, compliance, reputational, and business. RESPONSIBILITIES The Implementation and Trading Risk Analyst’s primary responsibility is to identify, assess, monitor and mitigate risks across Investment Implementation and Trading by partnering with business teams to strengthen controls, enhance supervision and support effective risk-based decision-making. Identify and assess risks and potential control gaps and partner with business teams to design practical controls, strengthen processes and drive remediation. Analyze incidents and other risk data to identify root causes, recurring themes and emerging risks and develop actionable recommendations. Develop and monitor key risk indicators, supervisory reporting and other data to identify trends, concentrations and changes in the department's risk profile, escalating potential areas of concern and remediation. Support the Investment Implementation and Trading Leadership Team by monitoring adherence to policies, procedures and established controls and evaluating whether controls are operating effectively. Conduct focused risk assessments of workflows, new initiatives and areas of elevated risk, translating findings into clear recommendations for business leaders. Participate in the development of a new first line risk framework that will raise awareness with senior leaders re our risk profile, provide data to make risk based decisions, take on a variety of ad hoc projects that include establishing the approach to keep stakeholders up to date Assess risks associated with business change, including new products, processes, technologies and workflows, and partner with stakeholders to identify appropriate controls and mitigate risk prior to implementation. QUALIFICATIONS The successful candidate is likely to have: Personal qualities and values that are consistent with, and would be additive to, Wellington Management's culture; Ability to work effectively and efficiently under tight deadlines and other pressures; Proven organizational and communication skills with an emphasis on accuracy, concision and timeliness; Working knowledge of Microsoft products including Excel and PowerPoint Ability to use AI tools to enhance efficiency Strong analytical aptitude and ability to perform deep-dive data analysis as well as high level strategic thinking; Ability to manage small projects Interpersonal skills, ability to engage with subject matter experts across the firm A minimum 3-5 years relevant work experience in the financial services industry; and Strong academic credentials; a Bachelor's degree is required Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background.
